prompt:
小红书信息图。排版：设置一个主标题，主体由多个层级组成，每一层左侧放置该层标题，右侧整齐排列多个带文字标签的图标，用于呈现不同层级之间的对比关系。使用纯色背景，保留较多留白空间，整体构图简单。

本次输入：【填写标题、核对过的要点、顺序或关系】。
有事实、名称、数字或引文时，按输入使用；信息缺失的模块留空或省略。
promptEnglish:
Xiaohongshu infographic. Layout: include a main headline, then organize the body into multiple tiers. Place the tier title on the left of each tier and arrange multiple labeled icons neatly on the right to present comparisons between levels. Use a solid-color background, generous negative space, and a simple overall composition.

Inputs: [Provide title, verified points, and their order or relationships].
Use supplied facts, names, numbers and quotations. Leave sections without data blank or omit them.
